estimands.note: Raw proxy magnitudes differ by edit. The primary sign test uses only paired direction; raw magnitudes remain stratified and descriptive.

seed_holdout.repository_seed_field_audit_before_sweep: No JSON/JSONL seed, noise_seed, or generation_seed field used 101 or 202.
seed_holdout.policy: Pilot-informed gates and decision rules; held-out confirmatory generation trajectories.

confirmatory.decision: Pass only if all protocol invariants pass, at least 7/8 edit-seed cluster effects are positive, the exact one-sided sign-test p-value is <= 0.05, each confirmatory chunk has positive median delta_E and at least 5/8 positive clusters, and at least 3/4 edit-level effects are positive.
confirmatory.magnitude_note: No post-smoke raw-score cutoff is introduced because color and luma proxy scales are not commensurate.

secondary.dose_response: Report cluster-level delta_E and D_drift across all gates; do not convert monotonicity into a pass criterion.

pareto.delta_R: R(g) - R(1) = delta_E / S_full when S_full > 0
pareto.decision: Report every non-dominated gate. Do not choose a single operating point and do not add a drift budget after seeing results.
pareto.normalization_validity: If any confirmatory unit has nonpositive S_full, the cross-edit Pareto frontier is not estimable; do not drop or impute that unit. Raw delta_E remains reported by edit.

invariants.historical_sealed_scope: The held-out 101/202 confirmatory trajectories have no historical result by design. Historical sealed availability is expected to be zero and is reported without imputation.

claim_scope.confirmatory_pass: On the preregistered held-out edit-seed units, releasing history to g=0.5 increases paired editability relative to g=1 under the exact consistency test.
claim_scope.confirmatory_fail: The sweep does not establish the preregistered causal editability claim.
claim_scope.inference_note: This is an exact consistency test on preregistered edit-seed units, not population-level significance for all video editing tasks; two seeds share each edit prompt and the separate 3/4 edit replication guard remains required.
claim_scope.pareto_note: A normalized delta_R frontier reports the editability-preservation tradeoff; it does not establish that any drift level is practically acceptable.
